## Improve the way you diagnose, monitor and manage your patients

With the Afinion™ 2 System, there’s no need to send test results to the lab or spend time tracking
them down. That way you can keep your focus where it belongs – on the patient.

[ Discover more ][64]

## i-STAT 1

A portable, handheld blood analyzer that delivers lab-quality results in minutes at the point of
care.

[ Find Out More ][65]



## Detect Dengue early with rapid testing

Dengue remains a threat and its symptoms can range from mild to severe flu-like. With high
sensitivity and specificity and results in 15 minutes, Bioline™ Dengue Duo is a fast solution for
field hospitals and large-scale testing.

[ learn more ][66]

*i-STAT cardiac troponin* I (cTnI), can be used to obtain quantitative measurement of cardiac
troponin I (cTnI).

[ Learn More ][68]

### Stay Ahead of Diabetes with HbA1c Testing

Diagnose diabetes and better manage patients with point-of-care Hb1Ac testing. Get quick, accurate
results enabling immediate diagnosis for better management.

The world's most sensitive rapid diagnostic test for detection of Hepatitis B surface antigen for
use with serum, plasma or whole blood.

    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

## We are Roche

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems.

[Coronavirus Test Kit - Covid-19 Test Kits, 2019-nCoV IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette]
COVID-19 Test Kits
[The blood glucose meter from Jal Medical is quite an efficient and simple to use device for
checking blood glucose levels. It is a very important device for diabetes monitor and provides
accurate glucose level in the blood. The blood glucose test meter extracts a small amount of blood
on which further parameters are measured. It only extracts about 0.7UL of blood for sample and
provides accurate results in about 6 seconds.]
Blood Glucose Meters
[Jal Medical is widely known to provide reliable and cost effective STD rapid screen tests that are
specially designed to save people from the mental stress while diagnosing sexually transmitted
diseases. The screen tests are available for several diseases, such as- Hepatitis, HIV through
saliva and urine, Chlamydia, Syphilis, Gonorrhea, etc. Most people shy away from STD testing, like
HIV blood test, as they are too embarrassed to face the situation. Those who manage to appear for
the tests are too fragile to collect results. The infections caused due to these diseases have the
tendency to spread from one person to another and hence it must not be left untreated. The Rapid STD
Test is thus a welcome change for these individuals in order to get their condition tested and hence
treated. HIV test kits by Jal Medical produce results within minutes instead of days taken by
conventional methods. Quick results lead to early detection of the diseases and as a result allows
for early treatment as well. For diseases like HIV, Syphilis, etc. early detection can go a long way
in the successful treatment, thus causing a lower risk of illness and a longer lifespan. The STD
rapid screen test kits provided by Jal Medical like HBsAg test, chlamydia test, rapid HIV test, etc.
are highly accurate. They are designed and manufactured carefully for STD screening and one can
completely bank on the results shown. For the Hepatitis B core Immunoglobin M Rapid Screen Test, the
specimen is made to react with the colored conjugate mixture. It then migrates chromate-graphically
on the membrane by the capillary action.]

getting passed on to other individuals in also reduced.]

## Improve the way you diagnose, monitor and manage your patients

With the Afinion™ 2 System, there’s no need to send test results to the lab or spend time tracking
them down. That way you can keep your focus where it belongs – on the patient.

[ Discover more ][64]
[Hero banner Image]
[Hero banner Image]
[Hero banner Image]



## MAKE AN IMPACT WITH
## i-STAT 1

A portable, handheld blood analyzer that delivers lab-quality results in minutes at the point of
care.

[ Find Out More ][65]



## Detect Dengue early with rapid testing

Dengue remains a threat and its symptoms can range from mild to severe flu-like. With high
sensitivity and specificity and results in 15 minutes, Bioline™ Dengue Duo is a fast solution for
field hospitals and large-scale testing.

[ learn more ][66]

### Lab-quality results in ≈10 minutes

*i-STAT cardiac troponin* I (cTnI), can be used to obtain quantitative measurement of cardiac
troponin I (cTnI).

[ Learn More ][68]
[ [diabetes solutions] [diabetes solutions] [diabetes solutions] ][69]

### Stay Ahead of Diabetes with HbA1c Testing

Diagnose diabetes and better manage patients with point-of-care Hb1Ac testing. Get quick, accurate
results enabling immediate diagnosis for better management.

[ DISCOVER MORE ][70]
[ [Covid-Antigen-Selftest] [Covid-Antigen-Selftest] [Covid-Antigen-Selftest] ][71]

### A new standard in sensitivity Determine™ HBsAg 2

The world's most sensitive rapid diagnostic test for detection of Hepatitis B surface antigen for
use with serum, plasma or whole blood.

[ Learn More ][72]

Discover how our rapid diagnostics solutions help address some of the world’s greatest healthcare
challenges – including yours.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems.

# Affordable, Compassionate Healthcare in Mansfield, Texas

## Transparent pricing. No memberships. No hidden fees.

### Primary Care, Pediatric Care, Mental Health Services, Chronic Disease Management, Advanced Wound
### Care, Laboratory Services and
### Diagnostic Imaging 

Quality care you can trust, with pricing you understand.

## Welcome to ALMS Community Health Center

### Clear care. Honest pricing. Real relationships.

At ALMS Community Health Center, we believe healthcare should be accessible, affordable and easy to
understand. That’s why we use an individual pricing model, you only pay for the services you
receive, with no surprise bills or unnecessary fees.


We proudly serve Mansfield, TX (76063) and surrounding Dallas–Fort Worth communities, offering
comprehensive medical services in one convenient location.

## Why Patients Choose ALMS

#### At ALMS Community Health Center, we are committed to delivering accessible, patient-centered
#### healthcare that prioritizes clarity, respect and long-term health outcomes.

### Integrated care that simplifies healthcare
* Primary care, pediatric and mental health services in one location
* On-site laboratory testing for faster diagnosis
* Coordinated care across providers and services
* Reduced need for outside referrals


This integrated approach improves efficiency, continuity and patient outcomes.

### Flexible care delivery options
* Primary care, pediatric and mental health services in one location
* On-site laboratory testing for faster diagnosis
* Coordinated care across providers and services
* Reduced need for outside referrals


This integrated approach improves efficiency, continuity and patient outcomes.

### Care built around the patient
### experience
* Taking time with every patient
* Explaining conditions and treatment options in plain language
* Treating every individual with dignity, respect and compassion
* Creating a comfortable, supportive care environment


Healthcare should never feel rushed, confusing or impersonal.

# Welcome

## **Are you a Nurse or Midwife?
## ****Get involved in research!**

Global Research Nurses aims to provide you with the support, guidance and information needed to
fulfill your role and enhance your career as a nurse involved in research. By getting involved in
research, you will play a vital role in improving patient care.

## WHO Good Practices for Clinical Trial Design and Implementation

### About HEPS-UGANDA@25

Coalition for Health Promotion and Social Development (HEPS- Uganda) is a non- governmental
organization (NGO) that promotes the health and socioeconomic rights of vulnerable individuals,
groups and communities. We were registered as an NGO in November 2000. We are a membership
organization, consisting of individual and institutional members who support health consumer rights
and identify with the organization’s values.

HEPS-Uganda works across all major regions of Uganda, at community, district as well as national
levels. We work in 23 of the country’s 135 districts and cities, with four field offices.

## ABOUT US

# THE BEST TELEHEALTH SOLUTIONS PROVIDER

**SK-Telemed GmbH **is a complete system integrator for IT solutions in healthcare business
processes. Collaboration with industry leaders in software and hardware, high competence of our
team, successful experience of implemented projects and stable growth of demand for our services
open another level of workflow for our clients. We deliver healthcare software development services
for hospitals, doctors, patients ensuring high level of digital healthcare service and health
management. Healthcare providers with our software solutions improve medical workflows, enhance
treatment, diagnostics and organize secure data transfer between healthcare departments.

SK-Telemed GmbH has passed the audits and is now certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and
13485:2016. [Read more about SK-Telemed GmbH][15].

**SK-Telemed GmbH is a member of **
**AAL Austria, Telemed Austria**

#### Mission

We increase a level of healthcare services with help of cutting-edge IT solutions.
With our solutions, healthcare providers improve medical workflow, enhance treatment, diagnostic and
continuous monitoring, organize secure data transfer.

#### Position

Our digital solutions connect doctors, patients, and partners. We develop precise digital tools for
remote monitoring, treatment, communication and care that really elevate the quality of medical
services especially in the COVID-19 era.

#### Strategy

We use mHealth, telehealth, IoMT, AI algorithms and other technologies to facilitate a diagnostic
process, to enhance a monitoring of the patients health status, to provide a continuous care, and to
give proper treatment solutions.

## PRODUCTS

[IDIS2GO]

**Telehealth medical diagnostic system IDIS2GO is a telemetry solution for remote diagnostic. The
diagnostic clinic just in one bag!**
* Open platform with number of portable connected devices (12-channel ECG, urine analizer,
  spirometer, blood pressure, glucometer, SpO2, dermatoscope, digital stethoscope, wireless doppler,
  fetal doppler, etc).
* Diagnostic in remote locations: rural areas, transport, production and military units.
* Remote access for medical specialists to diagnostic results.
* AI for doctor decision support.

[More information][16]

**Worldwide Doctor-to-Patient communication and monitoring platform. Show2Doc connects with the
portable medical devices. The complete health monitoring for home use!**

It allows virtual care with possibility of complete outpatient treatment without physical visits to
clinic: 
* convenient task manager
* chat for instant feedback
* doctor prescription fulfillment control
* user-friendly intuitive interface
* patient diary
* videocalls in necessary cases

[More information][17]
[Patient portal with the web and mobile app Medcard24]
[Medcard24]

**Patient portal with the web and mobile app. Medcard24 allows you to:**
* find doctors or clinics
* schedule the appointments
* check the personal medical data in EHRs/EMRs
* book the online-consultations
* recieve the electronic prescriptions
* find medicine in the nearest pharmacy and purchase it online

[More information][18]
[ePrescription]

**Unified system for prescription registration, accounting and monitoring**.

Single e-prescriptions database.
Identification doctor, pharmacist and medical prescription. Online reporting.

**This program was created to:**
* medical prescription process automation
* control of distribution of medicines to pharmacies
* creation of reimbursement register of drug costs
* analytical reports generating

Complete telemedicine module, with doctor’s time management, Doctor-to-Doctor and Patient-to-Doctor
remote consultation workflows, electronic health record (EHR), diagnostic results and video calling.

**Telemedicine portal includes:**
* Telemedicine consultation
* Video calling
* Home telemedicine
* Search of consultants

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

Hands-On Health Labs was founded on a simple principle: high-quality diagnostic healthcare should be
accessible, professional, and patient-centered.

set out to bridge the gap between medical accuracy and personal convenience.

to maintaining the highest industry standards.Every draw and specimen collection is handled with
clinical precision, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment to ensure lab-grade accuracy from the
comfort of your home or office.

patient comfort and clinical clarity, we help you get the health insights you need quickly and
safely.

[[ ABO & RhD Blood Grouping Kit]][106] [ABO & RhD Blood Grouping Kit][107]

Exclusive method

Solid-phase method

Accuracy rate: 100%



** **

**INTENDED USE**

The kit is intended to qualitatively detect ABO blood group system A/B antigen and Rh blood group
system D antigen in fresh finger prick blood/ anticoagulated venous whole blood.

Human blood contains a wide variety of blood groups, of which ABO and RhD are the most common. Blood
group identification is a crucial test item prior to clinical blood transfusion, and has important
clinical significance. When the blood group antigen on the surface of red blood cells comes in
contact with the corresponding antibody, red blood cells will undergo agglutination reaction, which
will eventually lead to hemolysis of red blood cells and endanger life. As a result, correct
identification of ABO and RhD blood antigens is an essential prerequisite to ensure safe blood
transfusion and avoid related diseases.

for qualitative detection of antibodies to Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) in human fingerstick
whole blood. The test is intended for use by untrained lay users in a private setting as a self-test
to aid in the diagnosis of HIV infection.

## ABOUT US

# THE BEST TELEHEALTH SOLUTIONS PROVIDER

**SK-Telemed GmbH **is a complete system integrator for IT solutions in healthcare business
processes. Collaboration with industry leaders in software and hardware, high competence of our
team, successful experience of implemented projects and stable growth of demand for our services
open another level of workflow for our clients. We deliver healthcare software development services
for hospitals, doctors, patients ensuring high level of digital healthcare service and health
management. Healthcare providers with our software solutions improve medical workflows, enhance
treatment, diagnostics and organize secure data transfer between healthcare departments.

SK-Telemed GmbH has passed the audits and is now certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and
13485:2016. [Read more about SK-Telemed GmbH][15].

**SK-Telemed GmbH is a member of **
**AAL Austria, Telemed Austria**

#### Mission

We increase a level of healthcare services with help of cutting-edge IT solutions.
With our solutions, healthcare providers improve medical workflow, enhance treatment, diagnostic and
continuous monitoring, organize secure data transfer.

#### Position

Our digital solutions connect doctors, patients, and partners. We develop precise digital tools for
remote monitoring, treatment, communication and care that really elevate the quality of medical
services especially in the COVID-19 era.

#### Strategy

We use mHealth, telehealth, IoMT, AI algorithms and other technologies to facilitate a diagnostic
process, to enhance a monitoring of the patients health status, to provide a continuous care, and to
give proper treatment solutions.

## PRODUCTS

[IDIS2GO]

**Telehealth medical diagnostic system IDIS2GO is a telemetry solution for remote diagnostic. The
diagnostic clinic just in one bag!**
* Open platform with number of portable connected devices (12-channel ECG, urine analizer,
  spirometer, blood pressure, glucometer, SpO2, dermatoscope, digital stethoscope, wireless doppler,
  fetal doppler, etc).
* Diagnostic in remote locations: rural areas, transport, production and military units.
* Remote access for medical specialists to diagnostic results.
* AI for doctor decision support.

[More information][16]

**Worldwide Doctor-to-Patient communication and monitoring platform. Show2Doc connects with the
portable medical devices. The complete health monitoring for home use!**

It allows virtual care with possibility of complete outpatient treatment without physical visits to
clinic: 
* convenient task manager
* chat for instant feedback
* doctor prescription fulfillment control
* user-friendly intuitive interface
* patient diary
* videocalls in necessary cases

[More information][17]
[Patient portal with the web and mobile app Medcard24]
[Medcard24]

**Patient portal with the web and mobile app. Medcard24 allows you to:**
* find doctors or clinics
* schedule the appointments
* check the personal medical data in EHRs/EMRs
* book the online-consultations
* recieve the electronic prescriptions
* find medicine in the nearest pharmacy and purchase it online

[More information][18]
[ePrescription]

**Unified system for prescription registration, accounting and monitoring**.

Single e-prescriptions database.
Identification doctor, pharmacist and medical prescription. Online reporting.

**This program was created to:**
* medical prescription process automation
* control of distribution of medicines to pharmacies
* creation of reimbursement register of drug costs
* analytical reports generating

[More information][19]

**Telemedicine platform**

Complete telemedicine module, with doctor’s time management, Doctor-to-Doctor and Patient-to-Doctor
remote consultation workflows, electronic health record (EHR), diagnostic results and video calling.

**Telemedicine portal includes:**
* Telemedicine consultation
* Video calling
* Home telemedicine
* Search of consultants

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.
